oneLiner: 卢瑟福提出原子核式结构，玻尔引入量子化轨道解释氢原子。
oneLinerEn: Rutherford proposed the nuclear atom; Bohr added quantized orbits to explain hydrogen.
detail: 原子里那点正电荷到底怎么摆，一度全靠猜。汤姆孙的枣糕模型把电子嵌在一团均匀正电荷里，可这撑不过一束 α 粒子。1909 年盖革与马斯登在卢瑟福指导下用 α 轰金箔，发现绝大多数直穿而过、约每八千个才有一个偏过九十度——卢瑟福后来说这“就像你用十五英寸炮弹轰一张纸，炮弹却弹回来”。要出现这种大角度反弹，正电荷就不能铺满整个原子，只能集中在中心一个极小极重的核里，于是 1911 年有了核式模型：电子绕核运转，原子内部几乎全是空的。有多空？把一颗 5.5 兆电子伏的 α 正对金核轰去，靠库仑斥力最靠近到约 41 飞米（2×79×1.44/5.5），而金核半径按 R=1.2A^(1/3) 只约 7 飞米，金原子半径却约 0.14 纳米，核与原子的线度之比约一万四千比一；把核放大到一粒细沙，最近的电子也在几十米开外。空到这个程度，恰好解释了 α 为何多半直穿。但纯经典的绕核电子要不断辐射能量、螺旋坠核，原子活不过一微秒——这一步把量子化逼了出来。1913 年玻尔给氢原子立了三条假设：电子只能在某些分立轨道上稳定运动而不辐射、角动量按 ℏ 整数倍量子化、跃迁时才吸收或放出一份光子。基态轨道半径 0.529 埃、电子速率约 2.19×10⁶ 米每秒（恰是光速除以 137），这两个数从此成了原子尺度的标尺。核式模型负责讲清“核在哪、有多大”，能级的细账交给「能级与氢原子光谱」，实验经过见「卢瑟福金箔实验」，人物小传在「欧内斯特·卢瑟福」与「尼尔斯·玻尔」；而这种抓住主要矛盾、忽略次要因素的简化，正是「理想模型」的一条样板。
detailEn: How the atom's positive charge is arranged was once pure guesswork. Thomson's plum-pudding model embedded electrons in a uniform ball of positive charge, but that could not survive a beam of alpha particles. In 1909 Geiger and Marsden, under Rutherford, fired alpha particles at gold foil and found that almost all passed straight through while roughly one in eight thousand scattered past ninety degrees—Rutherford later said it was 'like firing a fifteen-inch shell at tissue paper and having it come back.' For such large-angle rebounds the positive charge cannot be spread over the whole atom; it must sit concentrated in a tiny, heavy central nucleus, giving the nuclear model of 1911: electrons orbit a core and the atom is nearly all empty. How empty? Send a 5.5 MeV alpha head-on at a gold nucleus and Coulomb repulsion brings it no closer than about 41 fm (2×79×1.44/5.5), yet the gold nucleus radius from R=1.2A^(1/3) is only about 7 fm while the gold atom spans some 0.14 nm—nucleus to atom is about 1 to 14,000 in linear size; magnify the nucleus to a grain of sand and the nearest electron is tens of metres away. That emptiness is exactly why most alphas fly straight through. But a classically orbiting electron would radiate energy and spiral into the nucleus in well under a microsecond, forcing quantisation. Bohr's 1913 postulates for hydrogen were three: electrons stand stable only in certain discrete orbits without radiating, angular momentum is quantised in integer multiples of ℏ, and a photon is absorbed or emitted only on a jump. The ground orbit radius 0.529 Å and electron speed 2.19×10⁶ m/s (light speed divided by 137) became the yardsticks of atomic scale. The nuclear model answers 'where and how big is the nucleus'; the level accounting is left to Energy Levels & Hydrogen Spectra, the experiment to Rutherford's Gold-Foil Experiment, and the lives to Ernest Rutherford and Niels Bohr, while this grab-the-main-contradiction simplification is a textbook case of the Ideal Model.

oneLiner: 原子能量量子化；电子在高能级向低能级跃迁时辐射一份光子 hν。
oneLinerEn: Atomic energy is quantized; an electron dropping levels emits a photon of energy hν.
detail: 氢原子发光不是一道连续的彩虹，而是一根根锐利的谱线，经典物理解释不了，玻尔用量子化的能级一刀解开。核心公式是 hν=E高−E低：跃迁放出的光子能量恰等于两个能级之差，频率由差值定，而不由“电子本来跑多快”定。氢的能级 E_n=−13.6/n² 电子伏，n=1 基态 −13.6、n=2 是 −3.4、n=3 是 −1.51、n=4 是 −0.85，越往外越密、到 n=∞ 归零就是电离。跃迁落到不同的终态分属不同线系：落回 n=2 是可见光的巴耳末系（Hα 656.5、Hβ 486.3、Hγ 434.2、Hδ 410.3 纳米），落回 n=1 是紫外的赖曼系（首线 121.6、系限 91.2 纳米），落回 n=3 是红外的帕邢系（首线 1876 纳米）。所有谱线都被一条里德伯公式 1/λ=R(1/m²−1/n²) 一网打尽，R=1.097×10⁷ 每米——1885 年巴耳末先凑出经验式，1913 年玻尔才给出理论解释。能级分立不是假设而是实测：1914 年弗兰克与赫兹用电子轰汞蒸气，发现电子只有把能量凑够 4.9 电子伏才突然整份交出、把原子“点亮”，电流—电压曲线每隔 4.9 伏出现一个谷，直接描出了分立的能级（见「弗兰克-赫兹实验」）。这也解释了同种原子为何发同种“指纹”谱线，光谱分析据此能在星光里认出地球上的元素。算跃迁最常见的错有三处：丢掉能级差的正负号（吸收要升、辐射要降）、把 −13.6/n 而非平方代入、以及把实物粒子碰撞与光子激发混为一谈——光子必须“恰好等于”某能级差才会被吸收，而电子碰撞只需动能不小于差值即可。至于这些量子数背后更深、把“轨道”换成“概率”的图景，得等「波粒二象性」与量子力学登场；能级的能量单位换算归「普朗克常数」与「光子」。
detailEn: Hydrogen does not glow as a continuous rainbow but as a set of razor-sharp spectral lines, which classical physics could not explain and Bohr cut open with quantised levels. The core formula is hν=E_high−E_low: the emitted photon's energy equals exactly the gap between two levels, so the frequency is set by the difference, not by 'how fast the electron was going'. Hydrogen's levels are E_n=−13.6/n² eV—−13.6 at n=1, −3.4 at n=2, −1.51 at n=3, −0.85 at n=4—cramming closer together outward and reaching zero at n=∞, which is ionisation. Transitions landing on different final levels form distinct series: down to n=2 is the visible Balmer series (Hα 656.5, Hβ 486.3, Hγ 434.2, Hδ 410.3 nm), down to n=1 the ultraviolet Lyman series (first line 121.6, series limit 91.2 nm), down to n=3 the infrared Paschen series (first line 1876 nm). Every line obeys one Rydberg formula, 1/λ=R(1/m²−1/n²) with R=1.097×10⁷ per metre—Balmer fit it empirically in 1885 and Bohr explained it in 1913. Discrete levels are measured, not assumed: in 1914 Franck and Hertz bombarded mercury vapour with electrons and found an electron gives up its energy only in one lump once it reaches 4.9 eV, lighting the atom up whole; the current–voltage curve dips once every 4.9 eV, tracing the levels directly (see the Franck–Hertz Experiment). This also explains why one element always emits its own fingerprint lines, letting spectroscopy pick out terrestrial elements in starlight. Three slips dominate level problems: dropping the sign of the gap (absorption climbs, emission falls), using −13.6/n instead of over n², and confusing a particle collision with photon absorption—a photon must match a gap exactly to be taken, while a colliding electron needs only kinetic energy at least equal to it. The deeper picture that trades 'orbit' for 'probability' waits in Wave–Particle Duality; the energy units belong to Planck's Constant and Photon.

oneLiner: 光与实物粒子都兼具波动性与粒子性。
oneLinerEn: Both light and matter show wave and particle aspects.
detail: 光既是波又是粒子，实物粒子也带波长——这不是诗意的比喻，而是两头都有硬邦邦的实验。先看粒子这一头。光电效应里光打到金属表面打出电子，可经典波动说预言不了几个事实：能否打出电子只看频率有没有迈过门槛、与光强无关，光强只决定打出的个数，而且响应是瞬时的。爱因斯坦 1905 年照普朗克的量子说办，把光本身切成一份份光子、能量 E=hν，电子吃下一份光子、扣掉挣脱金属的逸出功 W 才剩下动能：hν=W+½mv²。门槛频率 ν₀=W/h，钠逸出功 2.28 电子伏对应红限约 544 纳米、铯 2.14 电子伏约 579 纳米——这正是“看频率不看强度”的模样（实验细节见「光电效应实验」，人物见「阿尔伯特·爱因斯坦」）。康普顿散射再补一刀：X 射线被电子弹回后波长变长，反向时位移最大 2λc=4.85 皮米（λc=2.42 皮米），只有把光子当成带动量 p=h/λ 的粒子、按碰撞来守恒计算才对得上。再看波动这一头。德布罗意 1924 年反问：既然波能像粒子，粒子能不能像波？他给出物质波 λ=h/p。电子穿过晶体确实衍射，戴维孙与革末、以及英国的 G.P.汤姆孙各自证实（见「电子衍射实验」）；慢中子 0.025 电子伏波长 0.18 纳米、100 伏加速的电子波长 0.123 纳米，都跟晶格间距同量级，所以能拿来探结构。那为什么看不见棒球的波动？把它代进去：0.1 千克、30 米每秒的球，λ 约 2.2×10⁻³⁴ 米，比原子核还小约十九个数量级，任何仪器都测不出——这就是“宏观物体波动性可忽略”的定量理由，不是没有，而是小得离谱。真正收束这一切的是概率诠释与不确定性：那列波不是实体在抖动，而是某处出现的概率幅；位置测得越准动量就越模糊，Δx·Δp≥ℏ/2，“轨道”一词在原子尺度不再精确（见「维尔纳·海森堡」「埃尔温·薛定谔」）。术语对照归「波粒二象性」，能量与频率的换算归「普朗克常数」与「光子」。
detailEn: Light is both wave and particle, and matter carries a wavelength too—not a poetic metaphor but a claim with hard experiments on both sides. Start with the particle side. In the photoelectric effect light knocks electrons off a metal, yet classical wave theory cannot predict the facts: whether an electron comes out depends only on whether the frequency clears a threshold and not on intensity, intensity only sets how many come out, and the response is instantaneous. In 1905 Einstein took Planck's quantum literally, slicing light itself into photons of energy E=hν; an electron swallows one photon, pays the work function W to escape, and keeps the rest as kinetic energy: hν=W+½mv². The threshold ν₀=W/h means sodium's 2.28 eV maps to a red limit near 544 nm and caesium's 2.14 eV to about 579 nm—exactly the frequency-not-intensity behaviour (details in the Photoelectric Experiment; the man in Albert Einstein). Compton scattering drives it home: X-rays bounced off electrons come back longer in wavelength, by up to 2λc=4.85 pm at 180° (λc=2.42 pm), matched only if the photon is treated as a particle of momentum p=h/λ and the collision conserved. Now the wave side. In 1924 de Broglie asked back: if waves act like particles, can particles act like waves? He gave the matter wave λ=h/p. Electrons diffract through crystals, confirmed independently by Davisson–Germer and by G.P. Thomson in Britain (see the Electron Diffraction Experiment); a 0.025 eV neutron has λ=0.18 nm and a 100 V electron 0.123 nm, both on the scale of lattice spacing, so they probe structure. Why never see a baseball wave? Put it in: a 0.1 kg ball at 30 m/s gives λ≈2.2×10⁻³⁴ m, about nineteen orders smaller than a nucleus and beyond any instrument—so 'macroscopic wave nature is negligible' is a quantitative reason, not absence, just absurdly small. What finally ties it together is the probability interpretation and uncertainty: the wave is not a thing vibrating but a probability amplitude, and the more precisely position is known the more momentum blurs, Δx·Δp≥ℏ/2, so 'orbit' stops being exact at atomic scale (see Werner Heisenberg and Erwin Schrödinger). The vocabulary sits in Wave–Particle Duality, the energy–frequency conversion in Planck's Constant and Photon.

oneLiner: 原子核由质子与中子构成，质子数决定元素、中子数形成同位素。
oneLinerEn: Nuclei of protons and neutrons: protons set the element, neutrons give isotopes.
detail: 原子核是质子和中子（合称核子）挤成的致密小球，记账用符号 ᴬ_ZX：Z 是质子数也就是电荷数、决定“这是哪种元素”，A 是质量数即质子加中子，中子数 N=A−Z。质子数相同、中子数不同的原子化学性质几乎一样、只是质量不同，互为同位素——氢的三兄弟氕（一个质子、零中子）、氘（一加一）、氚（一加二）最典型。中子来得晚：质子 1919 年被卢瑟福“看见”，中子却直到 1932 年才由查德威克确认——用 α 轰铍放出的那种穿透力强、又不带电的射线，靠它把石蜡里的氢撞出来再测氢的能量，才断定那是一种质量近乎质子的中性粒子（见「查德威克发现中子」；同期费米一伙人正在做慢中子）。同位素的存在最早靠质谱仪实测：阿斯顿拿它给氖拍出“两条质量线”，给“同元素不同质量”落了铁证（见「阿斯顿质谱仪与同位素实测」）。这里有个高频错点：化学里的“同素异形体”（金刚石与石墨、O₂ 与 O₃）是同一元素的不同单质排布，跟“同位素”完全两码事——前者差在分子或晶体结构、后者差在核里的中子数，背混的人极多。核有多小多重？半径 R≈1.2A^(1/3) 飞米，金（A 约 197）约 7 飞米；把这一核的质量摊到那么小的体积上，核物质密度达约 2.3×10¹⁷ 千克每立方米，即每一立方厘米约两亿三千万吨，一茶匙核物质就近万吨级——中子星正是把这种密度放大到天体尺度的产物。核子数还牵着稳定与放射性：中子质子比失衡的核往往不稳，那是「放射性与半衰期」的话题；把它们拆开要付的能量见「核力与结合能」。日常用得上的同位素例子极多，从测年到医学示踪，见「核能的利用」与「磁共振成像」。
detailEn: The nucleus is a dense ball of protons and neutrons (nucleons), booked as ᴬ_ZX: Z is the proton count, the charge, which fixes which element it is; A is the mass number, protons plus neutrons, so the neutron number is N=A−Z. Atoms with the same Z but different N are almost identical chemically and differ only in mass—they are isotopes, with hydrogen's three brothers protium (one proton, no neutron), deuterium (one-one) and tritium (one-two) the clearest case. The neutron came late: the proton was 'seen' by Rutherford in 1919, but the neutron was confirmed only by Chadwick in 1932—the penetrating, chargeless radiation from alpha-bombarded beryllium was pinned down by watching it knock hydrogen out of paraffin and measuring that hydrogen, proving a neutral particle about as heavy as a proton (see Chadwick's Discovery of the Neutron; Fermi's group was doing slow neutrons in the same years). Isotopes were first measured with the mass spectrograph: Aston photographed neon as 'two mass lines', hard evidence of same-element, different-mass atoms (see Aston's Mass Spectrograph & Isotope Measurement). A common slip to guard: chemistry's allotropes (diamond and graphite, O₂ and O₃) are different structural forms of one element and have nothing to do with isotopes—the former differ in molecular or crystal structure, the latter in the neutron count in the nucleus. How small and heavy is a nucleus? Radius R≈1.2A^(1/3) fm, gold (A about 197) about 7 fm; spread one nucleus's mass over that volume and nuclear matter hits about 2.3×10¹⁷ kg per cubic metre, some 230 million tonnes per cubic centimetre—a teaspoon weighs thousands of tonnes—and a neutron star is this density scaled up to an astronomical body. The nucleon counts also steer stability and radioactivity: a lopsided neutron-to-proton ratio tends to make an unstable nucleus, a topic for Radioactivity & Half-life, while the energy to pull them apart is in Nuclear Force & Binding Energy; practical isotopes from dating to medical tracers sit in Nuclear Energy and MRI.

oneLiner: 不稳定核自发放出 α、β、γ 射线衰变；半衰期描述衰变快慢。
oneLinerEn: Unstable nuclei emit α, β, γ radiation; half-life measures the decay rate.
detail: 有些原子核自己待不住，会自发吐出货、变成别的核，这就是放射线。1896 年贝克勒尔在铀盐上头一次撞见它，随后居里夫妇从成吨沥青矿渣里炼出钋和镭、“放射性”一词也由居里夫人定下（人物见「玛丽·居里」）。吐出的三种东西在电场里当场分家（见「放射性与半衰期」那条配图）：α 是氦核 ⁴₂He，带两单位正电、质量大，电离本领最强却穿透最弱，一张纸或几厘米空气就能挡住；β 是高速电子 ⁰₋₁e，穿得远些、要几毫米铝板；γ 是高能光子，不带电、穿透最强，得用厚铅或混凝土。三者偏转方向与强弱的差异正是判据。衰变方程只守恒两样——质量数 A 与电荷数 Z：放一个 α，A 减 4、Z 减 2，元素往下挪两格；β⁻ 衰变是核里一个中子变成质子加电子，Z 加一而 A 不变。半衰期是统计规律，指大量核里一半衰变掉所需的时间，对“单个原子何时衰”毫无预测力，也不随温度、压强或化成什么化合物而改变——常被误当可控。量级随手可得：碳-14 半衰期 5730 年，活物体内每克碳的 ¹⁴C 活度约 0.231 贝可，死后不再补充、按 5730 年减半，考古据此测年；氚 12.3 年，存放 20 年只剩约 32%，聚变堆的燃料因此得现产；钚-238 半衰期 87.7 年、每克放热约 0.57 瓦，正是航天器核电池的热源；氟-18 只有 110 分钟，注射用于 PET 的示踪剂三小时后掉到约 32%，所以回旋加速器得贴着医院建（见「粒子加速器」「云室与正电子的发现」）。辐射剂量是另一笔账：一次胸部 CT 约 10 毫西弗、相当于数年天然本底，“谈核色变”与“满不在乎”都不对，分寸见「核能的利用」。天然放射性的成因是不稳定核，归「原子核与同位素」与「核力与结合能」；人工放射性与正电子见实验条。
detailEn: Some nuclei cannot sit still: they spontaneously eject something and turn into another nucleus—radioactivity. Becquerel first stumbled on it in uranium salts in 1896, then the Curies refined polonium and radium out of tonnes of pitchblende residue and the word 'radioactivity' came from Madame Curie (see Marie Curie). The three emissions separate on the spot in an electric field (see the figure with Radioactivity & Half-life): α is a helium nucleus ⁴₂He, doubly positive and heavy, the strongest ioniser but the weakest penetrator—a sheet of paper or a few centimetres of air stops it; β is a fast electron ⁰₋₁e, needing a few millimetres of aluminium; γ is a high-energy photon, chargeless and the most penetrating, held only by thick lead or concrete. Their differing deflection and penetration are the very tests. A decay equation conserves only two things—mass number A and charge Z: emit one α and A drops 4, Z drops 2, moving the element two places down; in β⁻ decay a neutron inside turns into a proton plus an electron, so Z rises by one while A is unchanged. Half-life is a statistical law, the time for half of a large sample to decay, with no power to say when one atom goes, and it does not shift with temperature, pressure or what compound the atom sits in—often mistaken for something controllable. Orders of magnitude come cheaply: carbon-14 has a 5730-year half-life and living tissue carries about 0.231 becquerel of ¹⁴C per gram of carbon, so once intake stops on death the count halves every 5730 years and archaeology dates accordingly; tritium at 12.3 years leaves only about 32% after 20 years, so a fusion reactor must breed its fuel; plutonium-238 at 87.7 years and about 0.57 watt per gram is the heat source of spacecraft nuclear batteries; fluorine-18 lasts only 110 minutes, its PET tracer down to about 32% after three hours, which is why the cyclotron must sit beside the hospital (see Particle Accelerator and Cloud Chamber & the Positron). Dose is a separate ledger: a chest CT is about 10 millisieverts, several years of natural background, so neither 'nuclear phobia' nor 'carelessness' is right—see Nuclear Energy. The cause of natural radioactivity is the unstable nucleus, handled in Nucleus & Isotopes and Nuclear Force & Binding Energy; artificial radioactivity and the positron are in the experiment entries.

oneLiner: 核力把核子束缚在一起；形成核时质量亏损以结合能释放。
oneLinerEn: The strong force binds nucleons; the mass defect appears as binding energy.
detail: 把原子核拆开要费能量，这能量从哪来？答案是把“质量”和“能量”算成一回事。核的质量总比它所有核子单独质量之和略小，少的那块叫质量亏损，按「质能方程」E=mc² 折成能量放了出来——每亏损一个原子质量单位约对应 931.5 兆电子伏。亏损越大、要拆开的结合能越大，可比较不同的核得公平地“除以核子数”，这就是比结合能（每个核子的结合能），它才是核稳定性的真正标尺。曲线两头低、中间高，在铁-56 附近登顶约每核子 8.8 兆电子伏，故铁峰一带最稳。举两个硬数：氦-4（α）极稳，质量亏损 0.030376 原子质量单位、结合能 28.3 兆电子伏、每核子 7.07；氘核却只有 2.224 兆电子伏、每核子约 1.1，松散得多，这解释了为什么核反应一旦凑出 α 粒子就爱把它往外吐。曲线的斜率就是能源的方向：轻核往中间聚（聚变）每核子多绑住一大截，重核往中间裂（裂变）每核子也多绑一点，两边都朝铁峰滑、都放能。铀-235 每核子约 7.6 兆电子伏，裂成两块中等核升到约 8.5，一份差攒成约 200 兆电子伏的总账；氘氚聚变每核子从约 1.1 跳到氦-4 的 7.07，单位质量释放比裂变更猛。所以“重核裂变、轻核聚变都产能”不是巧合，而是同一张曲线的两段，分别展开在「核裂变与链式反应」与「核聚变」。要把这套账算通，还得认清核力本身：它是短程强吸引，两三飞米内远胜库仑斥力、超过约几飞米就骤停，正因短程每个核子只跟近邻结合（饱和性），比结合能才近似常数、液滴模型才好用；而质子间的电斥力是长程的，核越大攒的斥力越猛，重核因此趋向不稳定乃至自发裂变。质量为何能变成能量、守恒到底守恒什么，回「质能方程」「狭义相对论基本原理」；这套能量在工程上如何兑现，见「核能的利用」。
detailEn: Where does the energy to pull a nucleus apart come from? From treating mass and energy as one thing. A nucleus always weighs a hair less than all its nucleons do separately; that shortfall is the mass defect, cashed out as binding energy via E=mc² (see Mass–Energy Equivalence)—each atomic mass unit lost is worth about 931.5 MeV. A bigger defect means a bigger binding energy, but comparing different nuclei fairly requires dividing by the nucleon count, giving binding energy per nucleon, the true ruler of stability. Its curve runs low at both ends and high in the middle, topping out near iron-56 at about 8.8 MeV per nucleon, so the iron peak is the most stable. Two hard numbers: helium-4 (the alpha) is very tight—mass defect 0.030376 u, binding energy 28.3 MeV, 7.07 per nucleon—while the deuteron has only 2.224 MeV, about 1.1 per nucleon, far looser, which is why reactions that can assemble an alpha happily spit it out. The slope of that curve is the direction of power: fusing light nuclei toward the middle gains a lot per nucleon, splitting heavy nuclei toward the middle gains a little more each, both sliding toward iron and both releasing energy. Uranium-235 sits near 7.6 MeV per nucleon and its fragments near 8.5, the gap tallying to about 200 MeV per fission; deuterium–tritium fusion leaps from about 1.1 to helium-4's 7.07, hitting harder per mass than fission. So 'heavy nuclei fusing and light nuclei fusing both yield power' is not a coincidence but two spans of one curve, worked out in Fission & Chain Reaction and Nuclear Fusion. To close the books you must also see the nuclear force itself: it is a short-range strong attraction, overwhelming Coulomb repulsion within two to three femtometres and dying off beyond a few, so being short-ranged each nucleon binds only its neighbours (saturation), which is why binding per nucleon is near-constant and the liquid-drop model works; the proton–proton electric repulsion, by contrast, is long-ranged and piles up with size, pushing heavy nuclei toward instability and even spontaneous fission. Why mass can become energy and what is really conserved returns to Mass–Energy Equivalence and Special Relativity; how this energy is spent is under Nuclear Energy.

oneLiner: 重核（如铀-235）俘获中子后分裂，放出能量与中子，引发链式反应。
oneLinerEn: A heavy nucleus (U-235) absorbs a neutron, splits, and releases energy plus neutrons, driving a chain reaction.
detail: 重核吞下一个中子就断成两截、甩出能量和新中子，新中子再去打断下一个——这就是链式反应。1938 年哈恩与斯特拉斯曼在化学产物里认出了钡，迈特纳与弗里施用液滴模型算清这是核真的裂了开，并顺手用「质能方程」报了能量账。一次铀-235 裂变约释放 200 兆电子伏、平均抛出 2 到 3 个中子、亏损约 0.2 个原子质量单位。单次听着小，可一乘阿伏伽德罗常数就吓人：1 千克铀-235 全裂约 8.2×10¹³ 焦耳、只亏掉约 0.91 克（占千分之零点九一），却抵得上近二十万吨 TNT；广岛“小男孩”约 1.5 万吨当量、真正裂变的铀不到 1 千克（约 0.77 千克）、亏掉的质量约 0.70 克——“原子的能量”就藏在这零点几克里。链能不能自持，看中子跑掉的有没有比产生的多，这由临界质量说了算：燃料够纯够密、越过临界就指数暴涨（武器），掺入慢化与控制让每代恰好留一个中子（反应堆）。慢化剂要把裂变飞出的快中子（约 2 兆电子伏）降到 0.025 电子伏的热中子才好再被铀-235 俘获——轻水约二十次碰撞就够、石墨要上百一十五次，故堆型的分水岭就在“用什么慢化”；镉或硼的控制棒吞中子来调反应率，事故时全插进去“急停”。和平利用的起点是 1942 年费米在芝加哥一个球场看台下垒出的第一座反应堆 CP-1（见「恩里科·费米」）。再补一个反直觉的地质事实：二十亿年前天然铀里铀-235 的丰度约 3.78%（今天只剩 0.72%，因它半衰期短、消耗得快），浓到在某些铀矿里自己点燃了天然核反应堆——加蓬奥克洛就是证据，大自然早于人类造过堆。铀-235 之外可裂变的钚-239 靠铀-238 俘中子转化而来，牵出增殖与核燃料循环。浓缩、能量账的工程口径、快中子堆与核废料都归「核能的利用」；裂变碎片的放射性即「放射性与半衰期」的来源之一；那 200 兆电子伏为何存在，回到「核力与结合能」的曲线。
detailEn: A heavy nucleus swallows a neutron, splits into two, and throws out energy and fresh neutrons that split the next ones— the chain reaction. In 1938 Hahn and Strassmann identified barium among the chemical products, and Meitner and Frisch, with the liquid-drop model, showed the nucleus had truly split and cashed the energy through E=mc² (see Mass–Energy Equivalence). One U-235 fission releases about 200 MeV, gives off 2–3 neutrons on average, and loses about 0.2 atomic mass units. A single event sounds tiny until you multiply by Avogadro's number: 1 kg of U-235 fully fissioned yields about 8.2×10¹³ J, having burned off only about 0.91 g (nine ten-thousandths), yet equals nearly 200 kilotons of TNT; Hiroshima's 'Little Boy' was about 15 kilotons, with under 1 kg (roughly 0.77 kg) of uranium actually fissioning and about 0.70 g of mass lost—the 'power of the atom' hides in that fraction of a gram. Whether the chain self-sustains depends on whether neutrons escape faster than they are made, governed by the critical mass: fuel pure and dense enough to pass critical explodes exponentially (a weapon), while moderation and control keep exactly one neutron per generation (a reactor). A moderator slows the ~2 MeV fast neutrons of fission down to 0.025 eV thermal neutrons that U-235 readily captures—light water needs about twenty collisions, graphite about one hundred and fifteen—so reactor types divide on 'what moderates'; cadmium or boron control rods absorb neutrons to tune the rate and slam fully in for a scram. Peaceful use began in 1942 when Fermi built the first reactor, CP-1, under a Chicago squash-court stand (see Enrico Fermi). A counterintuitive geological fact: two billion years ago natural uranium held about 3.78% U-235 (only 0.72% today, since it decays faster), rich enough that some ore bodies lit themselves into natural reactors—Oklo in Gabon is the proof, nature building a pile long before humans. Beyond U-235, the fissionable plutonium-239 is bred from U-238 capturing neutrons, opening breeding and the fuel cycle. Enrichment, the engineering energy ledger, fast breeder reactors and waste all sit under Nuclear Energy; the radioactivity of the fragments is one source behind Radioactivity & Half-life, and why that 200 MeV exists returns to the curve in Nuclear Force & Binding Energy.

oneLiner: 轻核（氘氚）在超高温下结合成较重核，释放巨大能量。
oneLinerEn: Light nuclei (deuterium–tritium) fuse at extreme heat into heavier ones, releasing vast energy.
detail: 把两个轻核硬塞到一起就是聚变，可核都带正电、隔着几飞米时库仑斥力大得离谱，得让它们靠得足够近、强核力才接管——这要上亿度的高温给粒子足够快的速度。太阳正干这事：核心约 1500 万度、压强极高，靠质子—质子链分几步把四个氢挤成一个氦，净亏损约 0.0287 个原子质量单位、放 26.7 兆电子伏，同时甩出正电子和中微子——每平方米每秒约有 6.4×10¹⁴ 个太阳中微子穿过地球，几乎不与物质作用、却实实在在数得清。人类更好点着的是氘氚反应：氘加氚生成氦-4 加一个中子，放 17.6 兆电子伏，其中约 3.5 兆给 α、14.1 兆给中子。按「核力与结合能」那条曲线算，氘氚每核子约 1.1 兆电子伏、产物氦-4 达 7.07，落差极大，所以单位质量聚变释放远超裂变：1 千克氘氚混合约 3.4×10¹⁴ 焦耳、抵八万吨 TNT 级，每核子约 3.5 兆电子伏对铀的约 0.85。代价是“约束”二字——要么用强磁场把上亿度的等离子体悬空兜住（磁约束，托卡马克），要么用激光在一瞬内爆一小丸燃料（惯性约束）。中国 EAST 全超导托卡马克做到约 1 亿度、403 秒长脉冲高约束运行，国际 ITER 正在建、瞄准净能量增益；氢弹则根本不做约束，靠一颗裂变原子弹当引信瞬间点火、完全不可控。聚变的招牌是燃料近乎取之不尽：一升海水里的氘约 0.017 克，若全部聚变释放折合约 460 升汽油，而产物没有高放长寿命废料、也没有链式失控之虞。难点也实在：上亿度下没有任何材料能触碰等离子体、能量怎么稳住、氚如何自给。燃料之丰、太阳如何靠聚变过完一生并走向终结见「恒星的一生」，反应堆工程与“人造太阳”路线见「核能的利用」，被约束的那锅上亿度等离子体则是「温度与温标」「分子动理论」的极端版。
detailEn: Forcing two light nuclei together is fusion, but both are positive and at a few femtometres apart the Coulomb repulsion is enormous, so they must be brought close enough for the strong force to take over—demanding temperatures of a hundred million degrees to give the particles enough speed. The Sun does exactly this: at a core of about 15 million degrees and immense pressure, the proton–proton chain squeezes four hydrogens into one helium over several steps, netting a loss of about 0.0287 atomic mass units and 26.7 MeV while shedding positrons and neutrinos—some 6.4×10¹⁴ solar neutrinos pass through each square metre of Earth every second, barely interacting yet genuinely countable. The reaction humans light more easily is deuterium–tritium: D+T gives helium-4 plus a neutron, releasing 17.6 MeV, about 3.5 MeV to the alpha and 14.1 to the neutron. Read against the curve in Nuclear Force & Binding Energy, D and T sit near 1.1 MeV per nucleon while the product helium-4 reaches 7.07, a huge drop, so fusion per unit mass far outruns fission: 1 kg of a D–T mix yields about 3.4×10¹⁴ J, an eighty-kiloton scale, about 3.5 MeV per nucleon against uranium's ~0.85. The price is the word 'confinement'—either suspend a hundred-million-degree plasma in a strong magnetic field (magnetic confinement, the tokamak) or implode a tiny fuel pellet with lasers in an instant (inertial confinement). China's superconducting EAST tokamak has reached roughly 100 million degrees for a 403-second high-confinement pulse, and the international ITER is being built toward net energy gain; the hydrogen bomb, by contrast, confines nothing, igniting instantly on a fission primary and wholly uncontrolled. Fusion's selling point is near-limitless fuel: the deuterium in one litre of seawater, about 0.017 g, if fully fused equals roughly 460 litres of petrol, and the products carry no long-lived high-level waste and no risk of a runaway chain. The hard parts are equally real: at those temperatures no material can touch the plasma, energy must be held steady, and tritium must be bred. Fuel abundance and how the Sun lives and dies on fusion are in Stellar Life Cycles; reactor engineering and the 'artificial sun' road are in Nuclear Energy; that confined hundred-million-degree plasma is the extreme form of Temperature & Scales and Kinetic Theory.

oneLiner: 物质由夸克与轻子构成，靠规范玻色子传递三种基本相互作用。
oneLinerEn: Matter is built of quarks and leptons, with gauge bosons carrying three fundamental forces.
detail: 原子核之外再往下挖，物质的底牌写在标准模型里：两打基本粒子加几种“信使”。费米子（自旋为半整数、遵循泡利不相容，因此物质彼此不穿透）分夸克与轻子两族——夸克有上、下、粲、奇、顶、底六味，因“色禁闭”从不单独露面，只能三三成重子（质子=上上下、电荷恰凑成 +1）、二二成介子；轻子里有电子、μ 子、τ 子及各自对应的中微子，μ 子像“重一点的电子”、τ 子则更沉得多。把粒子黏在一起的是玻色子（整数自旋、专职传力）：光子传电磁、胶子传强、W 与 Z 传弱，2012 年确认的希格斯玻色子给别的粒子赋质量——希格斯本身约 125 吉电子伏、约 133 个质子那么沉，顶夸克更达 173 吉电子伏、约 185 个质子，比许多轻原子核还重。电磁与弱在更高能量下本是一体（弱电统一），四基本相互作用里电磁、强、弱都进了模型，唯独引力不在：两个质子之间引力只有电力的大约 8×10⁻³⁷ 倍，弱到量子引力至今没有实测。标准模型的预言准得惊人，电子磁矩算到小数点后十位仍对得上实验。可它远非终局：中微子竟有质量（模型原初设为零）、宇宙里看得见的普通物质只占约一成、剩下多是暗物质与暗能量，而模型拿不出一个候选暗物质粒子、引力也进不来——它更像一座盖到九成、缺了整层的新楼。宇称曾被认为在弱作用里守恒，1957 年吴健雄用低温钴-60 实验证明它不守恒（见「吴健雄的宇称不守恒实验」），说明连“对称”也得实验说了算。要找更底层的规矩，就靠「粒子加速器」把能量砸到一起、重演大爆炸后的极早期；反物质与正电子的发现见「云室与正电子的发现」，宇宙尺度的暗物质在「暗物质」与「宇宙膨胀与红移」，希格斯场的真空性质则牵进「量子计算」想模拟的那一类问题。
detailEn: Dig below the nucleus and matter's bottom card is written in the Standard Model: some two dozen fundamental particles plus a few messengers. Fermions (half-integer spin, obeying Pauli exclusion, which is why matter does not pass through matter) split into quarks and leptons—six flavoured quarks (up, down, charm, strange, top, bottom) that never appear alone because of colour confinement, binding as three-into baryons (the proton, up-up-down, charges summing to +1) or two-into mesons; and leptons—the electron, muon, tau and their neutrinos, the muon a 'heavier electron' and the tau heavier still. What glues particles is bosons (integer spin, force-carriers): the photon carries electromagnetism, gluons the strong force, W and Z the weak, and the Higgs boson confirmed in 2012 endows other particles with mass—the Higgs itself at about 125 GeV, some 133 protons heavy, and the top quark at 173 GeV, about 185 protons, heavier than many light nuclei. Electromagnetism and the weak force merge into one electroweak interaction at higher energy; of the four fundamental interactions the model takes in electromagnetic, strong and weak but not gravity: between two protons gravity is only about 8×10⁻³⁷ of the electric force, so feebly that quantum gravity has never been measured. The model's predictions are unnerving—electron magnetic moment matches experiment to ten decimal places—yet it is far from final: neutrinos turn out to have mass (the model set them to zero), ordinary visible matter is only about a tenth of the cosmos with the rest dark matter and dark energy, and the model offers no dark-matter candidate and no way in for gravity—more a building raised to ninety percent with a whole floor missing. Parity was once thought conserved in the weak interaction until Wu's 1957 cobalt-60 low-temperature experiment proved otherwise (see Wu's Parity-Violation Experiment), showing that even 'symmetry' answers to the lab. To find deeper rules, Particle Accelerators smash energies together to replay the earliest instants after the Big Bang; antimatter and the positron are in Cloud Chamber & the Positron, cosmic dark matter in Dark Matter and Cosmic Expansion & Redshift, and the Higgs field's vacuum properties feed into the problems Quantum Computing hopes to simulate.
